arc_filter_ladder.purpose: The survey's §4b.4 gate: the naive arc query is ~75% false positive and any build reporting a number between the naive and filtered counts has not applied the filter.

L1_naive_removed_then_added.definition: some statement has version_removed=R, another has version_added=A, both parse, A >= R. No modifier filter, no strict gap. `A == R` is the AbortController-in-Safari-12.1 trap: a partial_implementation upgraded to full support at the very version recorded as the removal.

L2_strict.definition: as L1 but neither statement carries flags / prefix / alternative_name / partial_implementation, and A > R strictly

arc_filter_ladder.gate_verdict: PASSED. The filter collapses 1,553 -> 326 features, a 79.0% false-positive rate against the survey's stated ~75%. The yield is 326 features / 705 browser-pairs against the survey's 325 / 704.
arc_filter_ladder.off_by_one_disclosed: This filter returns exactly ONE more feature and ONE more browser-pair than the survey (326/705 vs 325/704), and the extra one is in nodejs (71 vs the survey's stated 70). The survey's filter code was not available to diff, so the divergent case could not be identified. Disclosed rather than reconciled by adjusting a threshold. It does not bear on any conclusion here: the verdict turns on a baseline ceiling of 1.0000, which one arc cannot move.
arc_filter_ladder.naive_count_divergence_disclosed: The survey states the naive query returns 1,279 features. The nearest reconstruction here (L1) returns 1,553. The survey does not specify its naive query precisely enough to reproduce it, so the two naive definitions differ. Both land an order of magnitude above the filtered 326, which is the only property the gate depends on.

label_provenance.what_we_inherit: the GOLD. Which fact is in force in which (browser, version) scope is BCD's own annotation, maintained by MDN contributors, CC0, and pinned here by sha256.

This asymmetry is the instrument's honest weakness and it is load-bearing for the verdict below -- see `discrimination.authoring_dependence`.

discrimination.status: MEASURED, AND THE INSTRUMENT DOES NOT DISCRIMINATE
discrimination.why_this_was_measured_first: S6 established the rule the hard way: an as-of re-cut of MemoryCode broke recency identification completely (max(observed_at) fell to 0.0000) and was still saturated by a ~20-line read rule at 0.9064. Breaking the recency baseline is necessary and nowhere near sufficient. So the trivial-baseline ceiling was measured BEFORE any substrate arm existed, which is the whole reason this cost hours instead of four arm-runs.
discrimination.probe_construction: For each of the 705 strict arcs (feature, browser, live_from L, removed_at R, readded_at A), one probe in each of three bands: B1 (L <= V < R, supported), B2 (R <= V < A, NOT supported), B3 (V >= A, supported). 2,115 probes over 326 feature clusters. B2 is the discriminating band: there the NEWEST assertion about the feature is the WRONG answer.

good_news_the_recency_baselines_are_dead.reading: Every recency-shaped and frequency-shaped trivial rule scores EXACTLY 0.0000 on the discriminating band. This is a genuinely stronger property than MemoryCode has, and it is the property the survey promised. It is not sufficient.

scoped_interval.description: filter facts to the queried browser, take the greatest version <= V, honour removals. ~20 lines, no substrate, no index, no embedding, no model call.

the_killer.robustness_check: Re-run with INTERIOR query versions only -- never a declared version, so the rule cannot win by exact match -- on 2,075 probes: scoped_interval 1.0000, max_version_le_V 1.0000, all four recency baselines 0.6704 with B2 = 0.0000. The saturation is not a sampling artifact.

discrimination.headroom_note: Exactly zero on 2,115 probes. Not 'small'. Zero. There is no residual for any substrate to win, so the maximum achievable Delta between any arm and the honest trivial baseline is 0.0000 and the discordant-pair count against it is 0.
discrimination.authoring_dependence: The saturation is structural, not a bad choice of episode wording. BCD's gold IS interval containment on a totally ordered (browser, version) key, and the probe is indexed by that same key. Any probe whose gold is derived from BCD's intervals is by construction answerable by evaluating those intervals. The only way a memory substrate could beat the 20-line rule is if OUR episode wording obscured the scope or version badly enough to make extraction hard -- at which point the difficulty is entirely authored by us, which is the self-mined class this program already discounts, and we would be measuring extraction rather than memory semantics. Making the instrument discriminate and keeping the gold inherited are, on this corpus, mutually exclusive.
discrimination.what_survives: The census, the licence pin, and the 705-row arc table are all sound and are kept. What does not survive is the proposal in survey §4b that BCD can carry a retrieval decision about supersession machinery.

required_n_for_a_7pt_decision.computed_by: scripts/instrument_power.py, two-sided exact conditional McNemar, alpha=0.05, 80% power, D_MIN=0.07, power integrated unconditionally over N_d ~ Binomial(n, psi)
required_n_for_a_7pt_decision.note: Recomputed here, not inherited from survey §5; the table reproduces it exactly.

power.verdict: The instrument is NOT power-limited and never was -- 2,115 probes clear every bar in that table by 3x or more. It is CEILING-limited. Against the honest trivial baseline the observed discordance psi is 0.0000 and n_d is 0, which is below the n_d >= 6 floor at ANY n. No sample size rescues a zero effect ceiling, so the answer to 'at what n does this discriminate' is: at no n.

cost.note: One 925 KB tarball, one 6.5 KB licence blob, two stdlib-only Python scripts running in under a second each. No DB, no server, no port, no scratch database, no embedding model, no reader, no judge. Total spend on reaching this verdict: $0.
cost.spend_avoided: The survey costed the BCD build at ~1 day extraction + 3-4 days session synthesis + 2 days executable harness, plus a separately-authorised paid reader endpoint. All of it is avoided by the ceiling measurement, which took a fraction of the extraction day.
